STUDIO GUIDE

Listen in your room

  1. Connect stereo earbuds and load a local audio file. All speakers share its playback clock.
  2. Start a scan. Aim at walls and floors from several angles. Solid surfaces show observations. The dashed box estimates the rest of the enclosure.
  3. Double-pinch in open space to add a speaker. Pinch a speaker to grab it and release to drop it. Touch placement is available in scan mode.
  4. Carry the phone facing your listening direction in rear-camera mode. The audio follows the phone. Speaker positions last for the current scan.

The studio also works as a room simulator without a camera. Select a speaker to change its position.
